title: Symmetric ordinary Kunneth projection/exchange normal form
statement: Let C be a Grothendieck abelian symmetric closed monoidal coefficient category with functorial flat resolutions, and suppose etale upper stars preserve flat objects. Let p:W→X, q:W→Y, f:X→S, g:Y→S and h:W→S satisfy p;f=h=q;g. For arbitrary E in D(X_et,C) and K in D(Y_et,C), the native ordinary Kunneth map of [def-kun-kunneth-map] equals the inverse swap of Rg*K and Rf*E, then the ordinary projection map for g, then Rg* of the inverse swap of g*Rf*E and K followed by (Ex tensor 1_K) and the projection map for q, then the ordinary direct-image compositor Rg*Rq*→Rh*. Here Ex:g*Rf*E→Rq*p*E is the ordinary exchange of the commutative square. The exact formula is the attached Lean statement. No properness, Cartesian-square condition or projection invertibility is assumed.

Move the kernel swap through the ordinary compositor by its naturality. Expand only the generic canonical braiding and apply braiding naturality on the right; symmetric braiding involutivity cancels the kernel swaps.

lean.statement:
theorem kunnethMap_symmetricFactorization {S X Y W : Scheme.{u}}
    (p : W ⟶ X) (q : W ⟶ Y) (f : X ⟶ S) (g : Y ⟶ S) (h : W ⟶ S)
    (hp : p ≫ f = h) (hq : q ≫ g = h)
    (E : _root_.DerivedCategory (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology C))
    (K : _root_.DerivedCategory (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology C)) :
    kunnethMap C p q f g h hp hq E K =
      (supportedTensorSwapIso C S
        ((lowerStar C g).rightDerivedFunctor.obj K)
        ((lowerStar C f).rightDerivedFunctor.obj E)).inv ≫
        ((rightDerivedLowerStarProjectionMap C g).app K).app
          ((lowerStar C f).rightDerivedFunctor.obj E) ≫
        (lowerStar C g).rightDerivedFunctor.map
          ((supportedTensorSwapIso C Y
            ((upperStar C g).leftDerivedFunctor.obj
              ((lowerStar C f).rightDerivedFunctor.obj E)) K).inv ≫
            ((derivedTensor C Y).map
              ((derivedBaseChangeMap C
                (CommSq.mk (hp.trans hq.symm))).app E)).app K ≫
            ((rightDerivedLowerStarProjectionMap C q).app
              ((upperStar C p).leftDerivedFunctor.obj E)).app K) ≫
        (rightDerivedLowerStarCompIsoOfComp
          C q g h hq).hom.app _
